class.name: Account
class.brief_description: The player's account: signing in, their name and the email that takes their progress to other platforms.
class.description: Sign in first, before saves, achievements or lobbies: [method sign_in] uses Steam when Steam is running, Game Center on Apple platforms and Play Games on Android, and the online services (Trill) when [code]trill/url[/code] is set in Project Settings (otherwise each platform directly, or this device alone). To take their progress to another platform, a player adds their email address: [method link_email] sends them a code and [method confirm_email] checks it. From then on, every platform signed in with that address shares one account and one set of saves. The same two calls change the address later. [codeblock] var result = await Account.sign_in() if Account.needs_display_name(): await Account.set_display_name(chosen_name) [/codeblock] Calls that talk to a platform or the online service return a [Signal] to await. Its result is a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code], and on failure [code]error[/code] (a short code, listed with each call) and [code]message[/code] (for the log, not the player).

method.name: can_link_email
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the player can add an email here: the online service is set up and answered.

method.name: confirm_email
method.description: Checks the code the player received after [method link_email]. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code] and [code]merged[/code] ([code]true[/code] when the address already had an account, which this device now uses), or [code]error[/code] ([code]"wrong_code"[/code] for a wrong, used or expired code; [code]"wrong_current_email"[/code] or [code]"email_in_use"[/code] when changing it). Once added, this device's saves go up to the account; where the account already had a save in the same slot, [signal Saves.conflict] lets the player choose.

method.name: delete_account
method.description: Deletes the player's account and everything in it on the online service, as stores require games to offer. This device forgets the account too and the player is signed out: signing in again starts a new account. Saves on this device stay. Await it for [code]ok[/code], or [code]error[/code] [code]"offline"[/code] without the online service.

method.name: forget_device
method.description: Stops the device with this [code]id[/code] (from [method get_devices]) remembering the player. Await it for [code]ok[/code].

method.name: get_devices
method.description: The devices that remember this player as a guest (see [method LocalPlayers.confirm_guest]), for a "Devices that remember you" screen. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code] and [code]devices[/code], an [Array] of [Dictionary]s with [code]id[/code], [code]device_label[/code], [code]created_at[/code] and [code]last_used_at[/code] (Unix times). Needs the online service.

method.name: has_email
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the player has added an email address, so their progress follows them to other platforms.

method.name: link_email
method.description: Emails the player a 6-digit code for adding [param email] to their account, which they then enter for [method confirm_email]. To change the address once they have one, pass the new one as [param email] and the current one as [param current_email]. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code], or [code]error[/code] ([code]"bad_email"[/code], or [code]"rate_limited"[/code] if a code was sent to that address in the last minute).

method.name: needs_display_name
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the player has no name from a platform (signed in with a device account, or without the online service) and hasn't chosen one. Ask them for a name then, and save it with [method set_display_name].

method.name: set_display_name
method.description: Saves the name the player chose: 1 to 24 characters, shown to other players. It's kept on their account (and on this device), and stays theirs whatever platform they sign in with later. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code] and the [code]display_name[/code] as saved, or [code]error[/code] [code]"bad_name"[/code].

method.name: sign_in
method.description: Signs the player in, choosing the platform automatically. Await it: the result has [code]ok[/code], [code]provider[/code] (a [enum Provider]), [code]player_name[/code] and [code]online[/code] (whether the online service answered; without it the game plays on and syncs later). Signing in again while it's under way gives the same result.

members.member: This device's name, shown to players in "Devices that remember you". Defaults to the device's model name.

signal.name: not_owned
signal.description: Emitted when the online service turned the player away because the game only plays online for players who bought it, and the player hasn't, or this copy can't show it (one from a store Purr can't check). Online features stop for the session, as with [signal update_required]: tell the player they need to buy the game to play online. Saves still work on the device and the platform's cloud. See [Store].

signal.name: service_outdated
signal.description: Emitted when the online service is too old for this version of Purr. Online features stop for the session, as with [signal update_required]; the service's operator needs to update it.

signal.name: update_required
signal.description: Emitted when the online service turned this version of the game away ([code]application/config/version[/code] in Project Settings is below the game's [code]min_version[/code] on the service, or above its [code]max_version[/code]; either may be [code]null[/code]). Online features stop for the session; ask the player to update. Saves still work on the device and the platform's cloud.

constants.constant: This device alone: no platform, and no online service.
A device account on the online service, where no platform signed the player in.
